  public void execute() {
    int NUMBER_OF_HOLES = 10;
    int ind = 0;
    double hx, hy, hz, hr = 0.0;
    double CHEESE_HEIGHT = 20.0;
    double CHEESE_RADIUS = 40.0;
    double RIND_THICKNESS = 0.2;
    double HOLE_MIN_RADIUS = 0.1;

    model.component("comp1").geom("geom1").lengthUnit("cm");
    model.component("comp1").geom("geom1").selection().create("csel1", "CumulativeSelection");

      hy = (2.0*Math.random()-1.0)*CHEESE_RADIUS;
      hz = Math.random()*CHEESE_HEIGHT;
      hr = Math.random()*(HOLE_MAX_RADIUS-HOLE_MIN_RADIUS)+HOLE_MIN_RADIUS;
      if ((Math.sqrt(hx*hx+hy*hy)+hr) > CHEESE_RADIUS-RIND_THICKNESS) {continue; }
      if (((hz-hr) < RIND_THICKNESS) || ((hz+hr) > CHEESE_HEIGHT-RIND_THICKNESS)) {continue; }
      model.component("comp1").geom("geom1").create("sph"+ind, "Sphere");
      model.component("comp1").geom("geom1").feature("sph"+ind).set("r", hr);

      model.component("comp1").geom("geom1").feature("sph"+ind).set("contributeto", "csel1");
      ind++;
    }

    model.component("comp1").geom("geom1").feature("cyl1").set("r", CHEESE_RADIUS);

    model.component("comp1").geom("geom1").create("dif1", "Difference");
    model.component("comp1").geom("geom1").feature("dif1").selection("input").set("cyl1");
    model.component("comp1").geom("geom1").feature("dif1").selection("input2").named("csel1");
    model.component("comp1").geom("geom1").run();
  }
